title: Amazing Habit App with Useful Features
body:
I’ve been using various apps over the past three years, and this one has been the most helpful so far. I think you might like it too!

I’ve been using this app every day for the last thirty days. I find the interface easy to use, which is important since you’ll be using it daily. Plus, I really loved the ‘Habit Groups’ feature.

I purchased a lifetime subscription after trying it out for free. I’ll update my review again sometime later.
